title: Donald Trump shot down JD Vance’s proposal to send Indian troops as peacekeepers in Ukraine, claims new book
summary: US Vice President JD Vance proposed deploying Indian troops as peacekeepers in Ukraine shortly after Donald Trump began his second term. This suggestion was made during a January 30 Oval Office meeting, where Trump dismissed the idea, stating India wouldn't fund such a mission.
